loc.deep_gate.name: The Round Gate
loc.deep_gate.description: A stone gate as round as a shield and three times as tall. Runes around it read ONLY TOGETHER, and the gate only turns when several hands push at once.

loc.deep_hall.name: Hall of Sentinels
loc.deep_hall.description: Pillars carved as dwarven warriors hold up a ceiling lost in darkness. Two of them are not pillars.

loc.deep_vault.name: Sealed Vault
loc.deep_vault.description: Shelves of stone jars, most of them broken. A few still hold the old dwarves' remedies.

loc.wyrm_lair.name: Lair of the Ashen Wyrm
loc.wyrm_lair.description: Heat, ash and a mountain of melted gold. Something vast uncoils on top of it and opens one ember eye.

item.deep_elixir.name: Deep Elixir
item.deep_elixir.description: A thick golden draught. Dwarves drank it before battle, and after.

item.wyrm_fang.name: Wyrm Fang
item.wyrm_fang.description: A fang as long as a sword, still hot. The hilt was added later, by someone brave.

item.wyrmscale_mail.name: Wyrmscale Mail
item.wyrmscale_mail.description: Overlapping black scales that shrug off blades and fire alike.

npc.sentinel.name: Stone Sentinel
npc.sentinel.description: A dwarven statue that steps down from its plinth, axe raised.

npc.wyrm.name: Ashen Wyrm
npc.wyrm.description: A dragon grown fat on dwarven gold, its scales the colour of cold ash.
dialogue: More little diggers. The gold remembers every one of you.

q.ashen_wyrm.title: Only Together
q.ashen_wyrm.description: Behind the round gate under the forge sleeps the wyrm that drove the old dwarves out. It takes a group to open the gate, and more to come back.

steps.description: Open the round gate below the Forge of the Deep, with at least one companion.
